verdict.rationale: Medusa is a commerce platform, so live carrier rates, label purchasing and shipment tracking are fair questions for it. The pack has no evidence for any of them: the only related item is a bare 'Fulfillment Module' page title, with no content on carrier-rate calculation at checkout, label buying or tracking. A generic module title cannot be credited as this capability.

support.subject: As an operations lead, checkout shows live carrier rates and I can buy labels and track shipments from the platform
